title: Settings
resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to their default values? The office profile and the ERPNext connection are kept.

units.stelselHint: A new project starts with this unit system. Each project keeps its own choice, under Project data.

appearance.themeDescription: Choose a color theme for the application.

shortcuts.placeholder: Keyboard shortcuts configuration will appear here.

bureau.intro: These details and the house style appear on everything that goes on paper: the report, single sheets and the title block of drawings. A report uses this profile until you store it in the report with Update from office profile; after that, changes here no longer affect that report.
bureau.alleenSessie: Outside the desktop app the profile is not saved: it is kept until the app reloads.
bureau.naamHint: Shown on the cover page as the consultant, and in the footer when there is no footer image.
bureau.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG, at most 500 kB.
bureau.logoInKop: Logo in the header of every page
bureau.logoInKopHint: Also in the title block of drawings. The cover page of a report always shows the logo.
bureau.voetHint: Full page width at the bottom of every page (210 × 20 mm), at most 500 kB. Without a footer image a thin line with the office name is shown.
bureau.teGroot: {{naam}} is {{grootte}} kB; an image may be at most 500 kB.
bureau.lettertypeHint: The app ships with Inter and Space Grotesk. The others must be installed on the computer that prints; otherwise a substitute font is used.
bureau.geenConstructeurs: No engineers yet. In the report you pick the responsible and the executing engineer from this list.

mcp.intro: An AI assistant (such as Claude Code, through MCP) or another program (through the REST API) can work with this app: everything you can do in the app, from opening and saving a project to adding sheets, setting inputs, computing and exporting. The server only listens on this computer (127.0.0.1) and requires a token. Changes on this tab apply immediately.
mcp.alleenDesktop: The server (MCP and REST) only exists in the desktop app; in the browser there is no server.
mcp.poortUitleg: Default {{poort}}. After a change, set up the client again.
mcp.nieuwTokenUitleg: A new token breaks every existing connection; set up the client again afterwards.
mcp.alleenLezenUitleg: Reading and computing is allowed; the project, the settings and files are not changed.
mcp.pauzerenUitleg: Temporary: every call gets a message instead of an answer. Lasts until you close the app.
mcp.verbindenUitleg: Paste one of these into your AI client. The app must be running for the assistant to reach it.
mcp.geheim: These lines contain the token: do not share them.
mcp.restUitleg: The same functions as JSON over HTTP, with the same token as a header. Every route is in the OpenAPI document; that is the only thing readable without a token.
mcp.curlUitleg: Reads the open project. In Windows PowerShell: curl.exe instead of curl.

erpnext.intro: Take the location of a project over from ERPNext. The app finds the project by its name in ERPNext: that is the project number in the project data. The request goes directly from this computer to the address below.
erpnext.alleenDesktop: The connection to ERPNext only exists in the desktop app; in the browser the app cannot reach ERPNext.
erpnext.adresUitleg: Only https://; http://localhost is for testing only.
erpnext.geheimBewaard: A secret is stored for this address.
erpnext.geheimGeen: No secret stored for this address yet.
erpnext.geheimNieuw: The new secret is stored when you click Save.
erpnext.geheimWist: The secret is cleared when you click Save.
erpnext.geheimUitleg: The secret is kept in the keychain of the operating system, for the host of this address; not in the settings, and it cannot be read back here. Another address does not get it.
erpnext.geheimMislukt: The API secret could not be stored or cleared in the keychain: {{fout}}
erpnext.adresOnjuist: The address must start with https:// (or http://localhost for testing). No secret is stored.
erpnext.geheimAdresOnjuist: The address is not allowed: no secret is stored.
erpnext.geheimEerstAdres: The secret belongs to the address: fill in the address first.
erpnext.bewarenMislukt: The ERPNext settings could not be saved: {{fout}}
erpnext.veldUitleg: The field on the Project in ERPNext that holds an address or coordinates (such as 52.09, 5.12). It does not exist by default: the ERPNext administrator creates it, for example as custom_location.
